images.scope: Modern southwest Louisiana coastal scenery. USFWS places the refuge between Calcasieu and Sabine lakes. Already cited Atakapa/Ishak accounts describe the wider southwest Louisiana and southeast Texas coastal region; this image illustrates that regional environment. It does not identify a village, ceremonial place, reservation, historical boundary or every present community. Read the complete primary media record, its image identification, photographer credit and item-specific rights statement; read the refuge's opening location paragraph. Rechecked the regional geography passages of the existing TSHA and Darensbourg sources. Visually inspected the complete 3504×2336 original image, linked by the media record's Original download. No generated content, retouching or crops were applied. The complete available frame was proportionally resized/compressed for web copies without upscaling or retouching. Card/backdrop CSS crops and overlays apply; the page banner preserves the complete frame.
